topic: Hidden detail: Sabo's memory and the Mera Mera no Mi both depend on Ace's death
title: Sabo's Memory Came Back Because Ace Died
description: Sabo only remembered his brothers because he read that Ace had died. And he only ate the Mera Mera no Mi because Ace's death freed it. What If Ace had lived? The full story is on the channel.
tags: one piece what if ace survived
comment: If Ace had lived, would Sabo be better off, or lost forever? Pick one.

lines.text: Years earlier, a Celestial Dragon shot down his ship and he lost his memory.

lines.text: He lived as a Revolutionary and had no idea he had brothers at all.

lines.text: Then he read the news: Whitebeard and Ace were dead at Marineford.

shot.fallback: anime style dramatic pirate scene, no text

lines.text: It hit him. He remembered the sake cups, the oath, and Luffy.

lines.text: Now the second link. When Ace died, the Mera Mera no Mi was reborn as a new fruit.

lines.text: It ended up as the prize in the Dressrosa colosseum, and that is why Sabo showed up.

lines.text: He met Luffy there and ate the fruit that was Ace's.

lines.text: So here's my read: if Ace lives, Sabo doesn't remember, and there's no prize.
